bigIdea: Q3's decline came from broken onboarding, which we can fix, and a $4M retention plan returns us to growth by Q2 FY27.

beats.name: Opposition
beats.claim: Q3 was our worst quarter in three years.

beats.name: Escalation
beats.claim: Revenue fell 11% as churn doubled, and margin and cash fell with it.

beats.name: Turning Point
beats.claim: Customers left because onboarding broke, not because of the product.

beats.name: Resolution
beats.claim: We have cut cost and a $4M retention plan fixes onboarding.

beats.name: Aftermath
beats.claim: With the plan, we are back to growth by Q2 FY27.
